name: Exp_BinaryWave
summary: This EA trades based on the BinaryWave indicator, which is a composite momentum oscillator combining seven weighted indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX). It opens positions when the BinaryWave value crosses zero (breakdown mode) or changes direction (twist mode), with configurable permissions for buy/sell entry and exit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BinaryWave指标进行交易，该指标是一个由7个加权指标（MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI、ADX）合成的复合动量振荡器。当BinaryWave值穿越零轴（突破模式）或改变方向（转折模式）时开仓，并支持买卖入场和出场的权限配置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多指标合成动量波（BinaryWave），将MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI、ADX七个指标加权汇总为一个振荡器值，再经过JJMA等平滑算法处理。入场条件有两种模式：突破模式（breakdown）下，当BinaryWave从零轴下方穿越到上方时做多，从上方穿越到下方时做空；转折模式（twist）下，当BinaryWave值从下降转为上升时做多，从上升转为下降时做空。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈（分别默认1000点和2000点），以及当信号反转时根据BuyPosClose和SellPosClose开关平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值为按存款比例计算。资金管理采用百分比或固定手数模式，但缺少最大持仓限制和资金回撤保护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a composite momentum wave (BinaryWave) that aggregates seven indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) with configurable weights into a single oscillator value, then applies JJMA or other smoothing algorithms. Entry conditions have two modes: in breakdown mode, a long position opens when BinaryWave crosses above zero and a short when it crosses below; in twist mode, a long opens when the value changes from declining to rising and a short when it changes from rising to declining. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus signal-reversal-based closing controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose toggles. Position sizing uses the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management supports percentage-based or fixed-lot modes but lacks maximum position limits and drawdown protection mechanisms.

pros: 多指标合成减少单一指标假信号，提高信号可靠性
两种入场模式（突破和转折）提供灵活的交易策略选择
支持买卖入场和出场独立控制，策略配置灵活
使用新K线检测避免同根K线内重复交易
平滑算法可配置（JJMA、VIDYA、AMA等），适应不同市场特征
pros_en: Multi-indicator composite reduces single-indicator false signals, improving signal reliability
Two entry modes (breakdown and twist) provide flexible trading strategy options
Independent buy/sell entry and exit controls allow granular strategy configuration
New bar detection prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Configurable smoothing algorithms (JJMA, VIDYA, AMA, etc.) adapt to different market characteristics
cons: 七个指标全部使用默认权重1.0，未进行优化，可能存在冗余或冲突信号
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
缺少资金回撤保护和最大持仓限制机制
依赖自定义指标BinaryWave和外部SmoothAlgorithms.mqh库，移植性较差
信号反转平仓和止损止盈平仓可能产生冲突，未明确优先级
cons_en: All seven indicators use default weight 1.0 without optimization, potentially causing redundancy or conflicting signals
Fixed 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit do not adapt to market volatility (ATR)
Lacks drawdown protection and maximum position limit mechanisms
Depends on custom BinaryWave indicator and external SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing portability
Signal-reversal closing and stop loss/take profit closing may conflict without clear priority handling
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损止盈距离
增加各指标权重的优化功能，或提供预设权重方案（如趋势型、震荡型）
加入最大回撤限制和最大同时持仓数控制，增强资金安全保护
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt to market volatility
Add weight optimization for each indicator or provide preset weight profiles (trending, ranging)
Add maximum drawdown limit and maximum concurrent position controls for enhanced capital safety

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不适应市场波动变化，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止盈过小
MM参数为负0.1时为固定0.1手，无资金比例上限保护
未检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to market volatility changes — SL too wide in low volatility, TP too tight in high volatility
When MM is negative (fixed lot 0.1), there is no capital ratio upper limit protection
No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially causing duplicate entries
